about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: I'm a full-stack developer based in Madrid. In 2022 I moved into software development from an administrative background, and I haven't stopped learning since.
about.paragraph2: I work with React, Node.js and Tailwind CSS on the web, and Kotlin on Android. I care about clean, maintainable code built to grow.
about.paragraph3: I currently combine freelance projects with a vocational degree in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM).
